svg.text: A task and its tooling go into a sandbox with an agent; the controller inspects what comes out
A forecaster's job, stated as a product.
Each can be present or absent in a run.
No network. The task and the tooling are mounted.
reads, writes code, runs it, writes up
The submission is a fixed envelope: arrays,
numbers, code and a report. The trace is
every command and tool call, kept by the controller.
a private reference under every defensible
reading of the brief; a known wrong reading
is named as a pitfall; skill against withheld
the agent's own code on changed data: the
results must follow the data and must not use
a held-out year or a forecast from the future
Claude Opus 5.5, one narrow question at a time,
on exact quotations: does the report say what
the code and numbers say, in plain language?
which tooling was used, cost, tokens, time
No human per run. A scientist certifies each task's
an outside cause; never a fail
Each cell: pass rate, cost, time. Change one thing at a time.
The agent keeps its earlier work.
Compare with a fresh run: does work
accumulate, and what does it save?
Forecast tasks also take an optimised
With which model, harness and tooling can a forecaster's task be handed to an agent system and come back right? Per task, per system and per tooling, with the same checks each time.
